# Fresh Finish Cleaning Solutions

> Fresh Finish Cleaning Solutions is a London cleaning company providing contract office and commercial cleaning, school cleaning, end of tenancy cleaning, and communal area cleaning for letting and managing agents. It covers North, North West, Central, East, North East and West London, plus selected parts of Hertfordshire and Essex. Every clean is logged and photographed and saved in the client's own online portal.

## Contact

- Phone: 020 3927 4499 (+44 20 3927 4499)
- Email: info@freshfinish-cs.co.uk
- Website: https://www.freshfinish-cs.co.uk
- Hours: Monday to Sunday, 8am to 7pm

## Services

- Office and commercial cleaning: scheduled contract cleaning for offices, serviced offices, business centres and managing agents, usually out of hours. One named account manager per contract. Cleaners check in and out on site and every visit is photographed. Priced after a free site survey, with a fixed price and a written specification.
- School cleaning: term time cleaning for schools and academies with DBS-checked teams, plus deep cleans in half terms and holidays. Priced after a free site survey.
- End of tenancy cleaning: move out cleans for tenants, landlords and letting agents, following inventory and checkout standards. Before and after photos of every room. Anything flagged at checkout is put right within 48 hours.
- Communal area cleaning: weekly, fortnightly or monthly cleaning of entrances, stairwells, lifts, bin stores and communal glass for block and property managers, with every visit photographed.
- Also available: deep cleaning, after build cleaning and domestic cleaning.

## End of tenancy prices (starting prices, one bathroom included)

- Studio flat: from £120
- 1 bedroom flat: from £160
- 2 bedrooms: flat from £200, house from £220
- 3 bedrooms: flat from £240, house from £260
- 4 bedrooms: flat from £280, house from £300
- 5 bedroom house: from £340, confirmed after a visit
- 6 bedrooms or more: quoted after a visit
- White goods deep clean (oven, fridge freezer, washing machine and tumble dryer): £55
- Carpet deep clean: £80 per room
- Extra bathroom: £20

White goods are not included in the standard clean. Large or luxury homes are confirmed after a visit. Exact prices: https://www.freshfinish-cs.co.uk/end-of-tenancy-price-calculator

## How it works

- Every clean is recorded in the client's own portal, with before and after photos, visit history and invoices.
- Teams are trained and fully insured. DBS-checked teams are used for schools and sensitive sites.
- Offices and schools get a free site survey, a written specification and a fixed price.
- End of tenancy customers can price their property online and book; agents can book jobs in their portal.

## Areas covered

- North London: Islington, Camden, Highgate, Finchley, Muswell Hill, Crouch End
- North West London: Hampstead, St John's Wood, Kilburn, Willesden, Wembley, Harrow
- Central London: Marylebone, Fitzrovia, Soho, Westminster, Mayfair
- East London: Shoreditch, Hackney, Bethnal Green, Bow, Canary Wharf
- North East London: Stoke Newington, Dalston, Walthamstow, Leyton, Tottenham
- West London: Notting Hill, Kensington, Chiswick, Ealing, Shepherd's Bush
- Hertfordshire (selected areas): Borehamwood, Watford, St Albans, Potters Bar, Hatfield
- Essex (selected areas): Loughton, Chigwell, Romford, Ilford, Epping
